facts.text: CAM messages are /key:value pairs joined by spaces, for example b'/cmd:val /cmd2:val2'
Every message carries the client prefix /cli:python-leicacam /app:matrix
start_scan sends /cmd:startscan and waits for the reply that carries cmd
stop_scan sends /cmd:stopscan and waits for the reply that carries cmd
autofocus_scan sends /cmd:autofocusscan and waits for the reply that carries cmd
pause_scan sends /cmd:pausescan and waits for the reply that carries cmd
enable sends /cmd:enable with slide, wellx, welly, fieldx, fieldy and value true
disable sends the same /cmd:enable command with value false
enable_all sends /cmd:enableall value true and disable_all sends the same command with value false
get_information sends /cmd:getinfo /dev:<about> and waits for the reply that carries cmd
wait_for waits timeout minutes (60 by default) and returns an empty OrderedDict when it is reached
A reply is parsed into an OrderedDict keyed by the /key:value field names
The CAM socket connects to 127.0.0.1 port 8895 by default
COMMANDS.md documents startscan as start matrix scan, stopscan as stop matrix scan, pausescan as toggle pause of matrix scan and autofocusscan as start matrix focus scan
COMMANDS.md documents enable as enable single scan field and disable as disable single scan field
COMMANDS.md documents getinfo as information about the stage, z-drive, COR-ring, job list, pattern list, scan status, experiment, position, load position and autofocus mode and position
The README connects with CAM() and prints the reply of cam.start_scan()
